report.summary: Payments pod is failing to start due to invalid configuration value in latest rollout, affecting order processing.
report.likely_cause: Environment variable MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS set to invalid string 'abc' in latest payments rollout
evidence: payments pod restarted 3 times with exit code 3
config.py fails to convert 'abc' to integer during startup

suggested_action.detail: Revert payments deployment to previous healthy revision (v1) to fix invalid MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS configuration

rule_verdict.cause: the latest rollout of payments changed: payments: env MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS added = abc; its new pods are not ready (0/1) while revision 1 was (1/1)
